title: capsicum annuum var. minimum
intro: Capsicum annuum var. minimum, commonly known as the Thai Hot or Bird's Eye Chilli, is a small, compact variety of the Capsicum annuum plant species. This plant is a type of hot pepper that belongs to the nightshade family and is known for its intense heat and medicinal properties. The health benefits of the Thai Hot plant include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system due to its high antioxidant content. The bioactive constituents of the plant include capsaicin, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
